query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS manufacturing_steps (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  step_number INT NOT NULL,
  step_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  duration INT,
  temperature DECIMAL(5, 1),
  temperature_unit VARCHAR(10),
  pressure DECIMAL(8, 2),
  pressure_unit VARCHAR(20),
  mixing_speed DECIMAL(8, 1),
  mixing_speed_unit VARCHAR(20),
  equipment_id VARCHAR(36),
  critical_parameters JSON,
  safety_notes TEXT,
  quality_checks JSON,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS process_flow_diagrams (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  diagram_data JSON,
  image_url VARCHAR(1000),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
